scenarios.title: Only the chosen tier's mode happens on resolution

setup.notes: Thunder Magic (R, instant, tiered): Thunder {0}: 2 damage to target creature; Thundara {3}: 4 damage to target creature; Thundaga {5}{R}: 8 damage to target creature.

decisions: A casts Thunder Magic choosing Thundara, targeting Hill Giant, and pays {R} plus the tier cost {3} with four Mountains.
Both players pass; Thunder Magic resolves.

variants.label: thundara
variants.expected: Hill Giant is dealt 4 damage and moves to B's graveyard. All four Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: thunder
variants.delta: A chooses the Thunder tier (cost {0}) instead of Thundara and pays only {R} with one Mountain.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is dealt 2 damage and stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked. Three Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.title: The cost of the chosen tier is added to the total cost

setup.notes: Thunder Magic (R, instant, tiered): Thunder {0}: 2 damage to target creature; Thundara {3}: 4 damage to target creature; Thundaga {5}{R}: 8 damage to target creature. A's Mountains are untapped.

decisions: A attempts to cast Thunder Magic choosing the Thundara tier, targeting Hill Giant.

variants.label: four_mountains_thundara
variants.expected: The cast is legal: the total cost is {3}{R} and A can pay it with four Mountains.

variants.label: three_mountains_thundara
variants.delta: A controls three Mountains instead of four.
variants.expected: The cast with the Thundara tier is not legal: the total cost {3}{R} exceeds A's available mana. Thunder Magic stays in A's hand.

variants.label: four_mountains_thundaga
variants.delta: A chooses the Thundaga tier instead of Thundara.
variants.expected: The cast with the Thundaga tier is not legal: the total cost is {5}{R}{R} and A has only four Mountains.
